strings.JNR_SWORDS_GREATSWORD_DESCRIPTION: A single-edged greatsword that is tattered and dull. Skill: <style=cIsUtility>Stamp (Upward Cut)</style>
strings.JNR_SWORDS_GREATSWORD_SKILL_DESCRIPTION: Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.  Follow up with a <style=cIsUtility>Primary Skill</style> input for an upward strike dealing <style=cIsDamage>750% damage</style>.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_DARKMOON_DESCRIPTION: A <style=cIsUtility>Legendary Armament</style> bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. Skill: <style=cIsUtility>Moonlight Greatsword</style>
strings.JNR_SWORDS_DARKMOON_SKILL_DESCRIPTION: Raise the sword aloft, bathing it in the light of the dark moon. Temporarily imbues blade with frost. Charged attack release blasts of moonlight for <style=cIsDamage>250% damage.</style>, applying one stack of <style=cIsUtility>Frost</style> to any target hit.
